result:
The lookup was exposed because patient search fetched through plain `openmrsFetch` with no caching-strategy header, so the offline service worker applied its default path to every request. The fix is commit `e4aacbd5` (PR #2638, "Patient search should bypass service worker caching", 2026-07-24), which tagged patient search requests with `network-only-or-cache-only`. That header is now moot: offline support was removed later, so current requests are plain network calls.

**Evidence, best first:**

1. **The change, `openmrs-esm-patient-management` commit `e4aacbd5`.** It edits `packages/esm-patient-search-app/src/patient-search.resource.tsx`. It adds `cachingStrategyHeaders`, which sets `omrsOfflineCachingStrategyHttpHeaderName` to `'network-only-or-cache-only'`, and a `fetcher` that passes it to `openmrsFetch`. That fetcher replaces the bare `openmrsFetch` in `useInfinitePatientSearch`, `useRecentlyViewedPatients` and `useRestPatients`. The header name is `x-omrs-offline-caching-strategy` (from the removed framework docs in `openmrs-esm-core` commit `a62f8164`).
2. **Current state, `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-patient-search-app/src/patient-search.resource.tsx` lines 8–10.** At HEAD the `fetcher` is back to `openmrsFetch(url)` with no header. Commit `81c24905` ("(BREAKING) Remove offline support from patient management", PR #2776, 2026-09-25) removed the offline wiring, so the header no longer has a consumer.
3. **Framework removal, `openmrs-esm-core` commit `a62f8164` (PR #1894, 2026-09-28).** "(BREAKING) Remove offline & rxjs support from framework" removed the offline caching-strategy header constant, its type, and the dynamic-route service-worker messages (`RegisterDynamicRouteMessage`, `ClearDynamicRoutesMessage`). `packages/framework/esm-framework/src/deprecated.ts` lines 53–65 now stub `messageOmrsServiceWorker` to always return "No service worker has been registered."
4. **Related but not the cause, `openmrs-esm-patient-management` commit `ac5758f3` (PR #2742, 2026-09-14).** "Make patient search a little more light-weight" trimmed the visit representation and extended the SWR cache for visits to three minutes. It did not touch the service-worker path.

**Gaps:**
- **Ticket:** none. Neither `e4aacbd5` nor PR #2638 has a ticket key in its message, and PR bodies are not indexed by Falkon, so I could not confirm one.
- **Service-worker internals:** I could not locate the removed service-worker source at the parent of `a62f8164` (`d45e87b0`), so the "reopen the local database and rescan dynamic routes on every header-less request" behaviour is taken from your description, not verified in code.

  {"repo": "openmrs-esm-patient-management", "pr": 2638},
  {"path": "openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-patient-search-app/src/patient-search.resource.tsx", "startLine": 8, "endLine": 10},
  {"path": "openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/src/deprecated.ts", "startLine": 53, "endLine": 65}
]

Only the absolute bounds are used, which is what\nthe backend validates against too.\n\nIf the ranges cannot be fetched (older backends do not have the resource,\nand there is nothing to fetch while offline) the form loads unconstrained,\nexactly as before.\n\n* (fix) O3-5850: Page and bound the concept reference range request\n\nTwo problems with fetching every concept in one unbounded request.\n\nThe resource is paged, and REST defaults to 50 results, so a form with\nmore than 50 numeric concepts silently lost the ranges of everything past\nthe first page. A form could happily accept a value the backend then rejects.\n\nThe wrapper now fetches the ranges for the concepts of all numeric\nquestions from /conceptreferencerange before the form is built, and\nnarrows each question to the absolute bounds of the range that applies to\nthe patient. A bound already set by the schema is never widened, the\nstricter of the two wins. Only the absolute bounds are used, which is what\nthe backend validates against too.\n\nIf the ranges cannot be fetched (older backends do not have the resource,\nand there is nothing to fetch while offline) the form loads unconstrained,\nexactly as before.\n\n* (fix) O3-5850: Page and bound the concept reference range request\n\nTwo problems with fetching every concept in one unbounded request.\n\nThe resource is paged, and REST defaults to 50 results, so a form with\nmore than 50 numeric concepts silently lost the ranges of everything past\nthe first page. Each request now follows its next link until the backend\nruns out of pages.\n\nA single concept the backend cannot resolve also used to take the whole\nform down with it, since catchError turned any failure into an empty map.\nConcepts are now resolved and deduplicated against the schema's\nconceptReferences before the request, so references known not to resolve\nare never sent, and the remainder goes out in bounded batches. A batch\nthat still fails costs only its own ranges.\n\n* Update packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-schema/concept-reference-ranges.ts\n\nCo-authored-by: Dennis Kigen <kigen.work@gmail.com>\n\n* Update packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-schema/concept-refer","messageCut":"message cut to 2000 characters","ticketKeys":["O3-5850"],"pullRequests":[3546],"linksSource":"message, unverified"},{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart","hash":"c475517f81cd13876fa8bcaa37ba6c8c9444bf09","date":"2026-07-28T21:26:03.000Z","author":"Dennis Kigen","subject":"(fix) O3-5836: Pass patient-chart group props when starting a visit from patient search (#3513)","message":"(fix) O3-5836: Pass patient-chart group props when starting a visit from patient search (#3513)\n\nStarting a visit from a patient search result card launched the start-visit\nworkspace (a patient-chart group workspace) with patientUuid in workspaceProps\nand no group props. Snackbars were showing the generic OpenmrsFetchError message\n(\"Server responded with 400 (Bad Request) for url ...\") instead.\n\nProxy error pages (like an nginx 502/504) also arrive as a string\nresponseBody, so the body is only used when it's non-empty, 500\ncharacters or fewer, and contains no markup. Improve performance with multi-paged patient search results (#2554)","message":"(feat) O3-5714: Improve performance with multi-paged patient search results (#2554)\n\n* O3-5714: Improve performance with multi-paged patient search results\n\nSeveral notable fixes for the compact-patient-search component:\n\n* Previously, each call to `useSWRInfinite()` was, in essence, returning\n  new copies of existing data, which lead to unnecessary re-renders. This\n  has been fixed by setting `keepPreviousData` to `true`\n* Previously, when `useSWRInfinite()` set `isLoading` to `true`, all\n  results were replaced with placeholder. Since this gets set to `true`\n  even when, e.g., loading a second page of results, this resulted in\n  unnecessary unmounts and recreations, which was both a memory leak and\n  lead to a stampede of requests.\n* All search results were previously rendered and retained. This leads\n  to stampedes of secondary queries (e.g., for patient photos, queue\n  status, visit status, etc.). {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01HvHUBxkGYgBJNHQT1ohwZ9","type":"tool_result","content":[{"type":"text","text":"{"commits":[{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart","hash":"50773fe3f3d8253cf20e0f25dc0113ad8067f2b0","date":"2026-10-07T20:13:03.000Z","author":"Faisal Mehmood","subject":"(fix) O3-5957: Correct MUAC color code age boundaries (#3626)","message":"(fix) O3-5957: Correct MUAC color code age boundaries (#3626)\n\n* fix(vitals): O3-5957 correct MUAC color code age boundaries\n\nAges exactly 5, 10, and 18 fell into a gap between age brackets\n(e.g. age <= 5 vs age < 5 for adjacent cases), so no color code\nwas ever set for these boundary ages regardless of MUAC value.\nMade all brackets consistently inclusive on the lower bound.\n\nAdded regression tests covering the three boundary ages.\n\n* fix(vitals): O3-5957 align MUAC brackets with IMAM Uganda guideline\n\nAge brackets and MUAC cut-offs now follow the Uganda Ministry of\nHealth IMAM Guidelines (Jan 2016), Table 2: Summary of\nClassification of Acute Malnutrition.\nhttps://platform.who.int/docs/default-source/mca-documents/policy-documents/guideline/UGA-CH-38-03-GUIDELINE-2016-eng-IMAM-Guidelines-for-Uganda-Jan-2016.pdf\n\nSince age is the whole number of years extracted from the patient's\nbirth date, each bracket's lower bound is inclusive (a patient\nturning exactly 5, 10, 15, or 18 now falls into the correct next\nbracket). The old combined 10-<18 bracket is split into the two\nbrackets the guideline actually specifies (10-<15 and 15-<18), each\nwith corrected MUAC thresholds.\n\nSAM (red) cut-offs are strict less-than, and MAM (yellow) lower\nbounds are inclusive (>=), matching the guideline's own boundary\nconvention -- a MUAC value exactly at a cut-off (e.g. 13.5 for the\n5-<10y bracket) classifies as MAM/yellow, not SAM/red.\n\nReference example verified: a 5-year-old with MUAC 13.0cm now\ncorrectly classifies as red/SAM.\n\n* test(vitals): O3-5957 parameterize MUAC boundary tests\n\nConverts the boundary-age tests to a single test.each table covering\nall five age brackets at their red/yellow/green cut-offs, including\nthe under-5 bracket and the green case, which weren't covered before.","ticketKeys":["O3-5957"],"pullRequests":[3626],"linksSource":"message, unverified"},{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart","hash":"d0f4b1bf5be04ad6f9c567635864b36de6ac36c3","date":"2026-10-07T13:20:03.000Z","author":"Veronica Mukuhi Muthee","subject":"(feat) O3-5823: Capture diagnosis rank and certainty in the visit note (#3621)","message":"(feat) O3-5823: Capture diagnosis rank and certainty in the visit note (#3621)","ticketKeys":["O3-5823"],"pullRequests":[3621],"linksSource":"message, unverified"},{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core","hash":"744dd2abdf636d1fc4b3b6b163220e6995378022","date":"2026-10-05T22:55:54.000Z","author":"Ian","subject":"(fix) Framework and E2E test fixes (#1934)","message":"(fix) Framework and E2E test fixes (#1934)\n\n* (fix) Framework and E2E test fixes\n\n* The logout spec now gets a session of its own so it doesn't race the\n  shared auth store.\n* O3-5982: `getTranslationOverrides()` always settles whereas previously\n  it could hang indefinitely.\n* O3-5975: `useConfig()` now uses only a single suspense promise per\n  config id and drops it when it settles, so re-renders of the same\n  component wait on the same promise. This promise now doesn't settle\n  until the config does.\n* Several scripts _here only_ depend on '^build' of the framework. This\n  is correctly reflected in the turbo setup. This only applies to esm-core.\n* The E2E scripts don't strictly depend on `docker`\n\n* Simplify comment","ticketKeys":["O3-5982","O3-5975"],"pullRequests":[1934],"linksSource":"message, unverified"},{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart","hash":"c7d6eb8dcec4dc4ce60a285798920842d88820d2","date":"2026-10-05T13:15:35.000Z","author":"Kalyango Timothy","subject":"(fix) O3-5976: Fix Angular locale import requesting non-existent .mjs files (#3657)","message":"(fix) O3-5976: Fix Angular locale import requesting non-existent .mjs files (#3657)\n\nCo-authored-by: Dennis Kigen <kigen.work@gmail.com>","ticketKeys":["O3-5976"],"pullRequests":[3657],"linksSource":"message, unverified"},{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-management","hash":"ff624012f906133cc0594d87e89063b9cf85463f","date":"2026-10-05T10:48:19.000Z","author":"Dennis Kigen","subject":"(fix) O3-5666: Handle Call action failures in the queue table (#2789)","message":"(fix) O3-5666: Handle Call action failures in the queue table (#2789)\n\n* (fix) O3-5666: Handle Call action failures in the queue table\n\nThe Call row action and the Serve button in the call modal both post to\nqueueutil/assignticket without handling a rejection, so a failed request\nbecame an unhandled promise rejection: a full-screen error overlay in\ndevelopment builds and a click that did nothing in production.\n\nCatch the Call request's failure and show an error snackbar with the\nserver's message, falling back to a generic one. Give the Serve modal's\nticket display request its own rejection handler. By then the queue\nentry has already been transitioned, so say that, close the modal and\nrefresh the queue.\n\n* Show the server's message in the Serve modal's other error handlers\n\nThe Serve and Requeue failure handlers passed error.message to the\nsnackbar, which is the fetch wrapper's \"Server responded with 500 ...\"\nrather than the message the server sent. Use getErrorMessage with the\ngeneric fallback, matching the ticket display handler in the same modal\nand the other queue entry modals.\n\n* Assert the queue refresh in the call modal's ticket display failure test\n\nShare the mutateQueueEntries mock in the call modal tests so the ticket\ndisplay failure test can assert that the queue entries are refreshed after\nthe modal closes.\n\nAlso drop the toBeEnabled assertion from the Call action failure test.\nNothing disables the Call button, so the assertion could never fail.\n\n* Navigate to the patient chart when the ticket display update fails\n\nWhen serving a patient, the queue entry is transitioned before the ticket\ndisplay is updated. The old combined 10-<18 bracket is split into the two\nbrackets the guideline actually specifies (10-<15 and 15-<18), each\nwith corrected MUAC thresholds.\n\nSAM (red) cut-offs are strict less-than, and MAM (yellow) lower\nbounds are inclusive (>=), matching the guideline's own boundary\nconvention -- a MUAC value exactly at a cut-off (e.g. 13.5 for the\n5-<10y bracket) classifies as MAM/yellow, not SAM/red.\n\nReference example verified: a 5-year-old with MUAC 13.0cm now\ncorrectly classifies as red/SAM.\n\n* test(vitals): O3-5957 parameterize MUAC boundary tests\n\nConverts the boundary-age tests to a single test.each table covering\nall five age brackets at their red/yellow/green cut-offs, including\nthe under-5 bracket and the green case, which weren't covered before.","ticketKeys":["O3-5957"],"pullRequests":[3626],"linksSource":"message, unverified"},{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart","hash":"d0f4b1bf5be04ad6f9c567635864b36de6ac36c3","date":"2026-10-07T13:20:03.000Z","author":"Veronica Mukuhi Muthee","subject":"(feat) O3-5823: Capture diagnosis rank and certainty in the visit note (#3621)","message":"(feat) O3-5823: Capture diagnosis rank and certainty in the visit note (#3621)","ticketKeys":["O3-5823"],"pullRequests":[3621],"linksSource":"message, unverified"},{"repo":"github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core","hash":"744dd2abdf636d1fc4b3b6b163220e6995378022","date":"2026-10-05T22:55:54.000Z","author":"Ian","subject":"(fix) Framework and E2E test fixes (#1934)","message":"(fix) Framework and E2E test fixes (#1934)\n\n* (fix) Framework and E2E test fixes\n\n* The logout spec now gets a session of its own so it doesn't race the\n  shared auth store.\n* O3-5982: `getTranslationOverrides()` always settles whereas previously\n  it could hang indefinitely.\n* O3-5975: `useConfig()` now uses only a single suspense promise per\n  config id and drops it when it settles, so re-renders of the same\n  component wait on the same promise. That fetcher replaces the bare `openmrsFetch` in `useInfinitePatientSearch`, `useRecentlyViewedPatients` and `useRestPatients`.
